connector.name: MOVA MCP Connector
connector.registryDescription: Thin MOVA MCP proxy for bindings, transport resolution, and upstream tools/call execution.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mova-mcp-connector:0.1.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mova-compact account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
